Authors.Name: Generated from Bearded Theme Black & Diamond (VS Code)

KPlugin.Description: A KDE Plasma 6 global theme generated to match the 'Bearded Theme Black & Diamond' VS Code color theme: near-black backgrounds with a cyan accent and gold cursor/highlight tones. Uses the 'Bearded Icons' icon theme ported from the matching VS Code icon pack.
KPlugin.Name: Bearded Diamond
